newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Ukraine ship attached in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine ship attached in Bangladesh.

text.p: Bangladesh's admiralty court has ordered a Ukrainian-flag ship to remain attached (anchored) at Bangladesh's Chittagong port until claims for compensation by local importers are settled, port officials said on Monday.
They said the attachment was ordered on Sunday because the M.V. Sokol, a bulk carrier, had failed to keep schedule for arriving at the Chittagong port on April 24.
Local consignees R.R. Enterprise and Takdir Traders lodged a complaint with the court, demanding compensation worth ten 10 million taka ($230,000) from the ship's owners.

They said the ship carrying 23,000 tonnes of mustard seed from Russia arrived at Chittagong on July 7, two and half months behind schedule, which caused them financial losses in terms of bank interest, surcharge imposed in the new budget and fall of seed price in the local market.

The ship's Bangladesh agent, Seacom Shipping Limited, said its arrival was delayed because of bad weather at sea and labour unrest at two Indian ports which it also touched on its way to Bangladesh. ($ = 43.55 Bangladesh Taka)
